name: Button Men
summary: Two-player dueling dice game where each button defines a personal set of dice used to capture the opponent's dice.
rules_text: Each player picks a Button that lists its dice, e.g. 3d6 2d10. A match is best of five rounds. To start a round both players roll all their dice at once; rolls are public. Players alternate turns. On your turn you must make a capture if able: a power attack uses one die whose value is at least the value of one opposing die to capture it; a skill attack uses any number of your dice whose values sum exactly to the value of one opposing die to capture it. Special skills on some dice modify this, but share the same structure. Captured dice are set aside and all dice used in the attack are rerolled immediately. If you cannot capture you must pass. When one player has no dice left, the round ends. The player who captured dice with higher total face-count (sum of sides, not rolled values) wins the round, and first to win three rounds wins the match.
rating_reason: Two-player dice combat, turn-based strategic, fits engine well
